title: Order Types

edits.reason: Intro bullet teaches 'Limit Buy = placed BELOW market price (waits for price to fall).' The def draws the Limit Buy level at 85 but only pins 'Market Price' as a markPoint event on candle 0 — there is no horizontal level showing WHERE market sits. Adding a market-price line at 100 (the chart's start price, inside the 83-102 band) makes the 'rests below market' relationship visible as a level-vs-level gap against the Limit Buy line at 85. Gray #888888 because market price is side-neutral here, not a bullish/bearish signal.

notes: lessonChart already draws the full SL demo trade: Entry @85 (teal) + Stop Loss @80 (pink) with event pins (Entry Long, Trade Running, Reversal Warning, SL Fires) — the lesson is a stop-loss/invalidation demo, no Take-Profit is taught (price runs to 107 then reverses into the SL), so nothing missing. quiz.chart correctly draws only DECISION context pre-cut (Planned Entry @86 + Support Zone 84-89) with cutIndex 8, and routes the OUTCOME (Limit Buy Fills / Bounce Begins / Trade Running) to revealMarkPoints — does not spoil the answer; correct.
